verdict.rationale: An email marketing SaaS with a built-in AI Assistant could reasonably offer controls over AI training on customer data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an opt-out from AI model training or any data-usage policy for AI. The AI Assistant reference (docs-15) describes content generation only, not training controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
